messages:
nina: quick thread: we keep seeing fncall schema errors in the dashboard but no clear way to group them. proposing a lightweight 'annotator-lite' that only emits error_tag + fingerprint + sample_weight.

sahil: keep it async and low-risk. sample_weight is important so Product can estimate totals from samples.

devon: agree. fingerprint must be deterministic. propose canonicalization rules: strip request_id/ts, redact emails, stable key ordering. Keep canonicalizer version in the event.

olivia: privacy: redacted sample only, default retention 30d, enterprise opt-in for raw captures behind KMS.

ops-bot: Ops note: create FF fncall_annotator_lite default 0.005, metric annotator_lite.processed_events.

nina: UI ask: Console needs a facet for error_tag and a small fingerprint leaderboard with a 'confidence' pill showing sampling variance.

devon: will deliver reference libs in py/go/ts. also add unit tests + a fuzzer to detect collisions.

sahil: i'll draft the short RFC with event schema and rollout stages. if no objections, start internal sampling at 0.5% and iterate.

olivia: add compliance checklist before any customer-level capture.

ops-bot: Action created: FF fncall_annotator_lite at 0.005.

nina: thanks all, i'll open the RFC and a small Console mock.
